title: Ukraine Shrugs Off Trump Call to Ditch Zelensky for Energy Strikes
summary_full: President Trump lashed out at President Volodymyr Zelensky for striking Russian oil refineries. Mr. Zelensky said he’ll stop — if Russia does too.
